title: Concept: Honeycomb ingest key in a response
description: A Honeycomb ingest endpoint with the team header key in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The ingest key writes events into the environment, so injected events can drown the traces an engineer would use to reconstruct an intrusion.
